```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Fetch metadata from PE API
        run: |
          python fetch_metadata.py

      - name: Trigger Vercel deployment
        env:
          MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST $MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK
```
